stops.title: Home
stops.text: Mixes made from your taste, and memories from years back.

branch.title: Lost Memories
branch.text: Rediscover what you were listening to years ago.

stops.title: Mixes
stops.text: Mixes from how you listen, from old favorites to tracks you never played, and lots in between.

tiles.title: Recommended
tiles.text: What you're into lately, and what you played around this time last year.

tiles.title: Supremacy
tiles.text: The playing track, and the tracks you usually play with it.

tiles.title: Underrated
tiles.text: Tracks you played only a few times and haven't heard in a while.

tiles.title: Lost Partners
tiles.text: Tracks you used to play a lot but haven't heard in a long time.

tiles.title: Discover
tiles.text: Tracks you never played, or barely played.

stops.title: Playlists
stops.text: Every kind of playlist, in one place.

branch.title: Playlist Tags
branch.text: Group playlists by tags, and sorting never loses your own order.

stops.title: History
stops.text: Every listen kept forever, jump back to any day or listen.

branch.title: Jump to Day
branch.text: Go back to any day of your history, or the same day in another year.

branch.title: Track Listens
branch.text: See every time you played a track, in a list or a calendar.

branch.title: History Import
branch.text: Bring your history from YouTube, Last.fm, Spotify and ListenBrainz.

stops.title: Most Played
stops.text: Your top tracks from any moment in time.

branch.title: Time Ranges
branch.text: Slide through periods, or pick a day with the days around it.

stops.title: Smart Playlists
stops.text: Playlists that build themselves.

branch.title: Rules
branch.text: Rules for almost anything, from listens between two dates to late night plays.

branch.title: Limits
branch.text: Keep it to 25 tracks, an hour or a few GB, picked by any sort.

stops.title: Search
stops.text: Search the whole library at once, even inside lyrics.

android.title: Search Button
android.text: Swipe up on it to open the keyboard, and down to close it.

stops.title: Cloud & Servers
stops.text: Play from Jellyfin, Subsonic, a NAS or the cloud, and keep tracks for offline.

stops.title: Sorting
stops.text: Sort by anything, in any order, and save it for later.

tiles.title: Multi Sort
tiles.text: Sort by more than one thing, like artist, then year, then title.

tiles.title: Smart Order
tiles.text: Ignore "The", and sort non-Latin titles by their Latin reading.

tiles.title: Sort Presets
tiles.text: Save the sorts you use most, by name.

tiles.title: Random (Daily)
tiles.text: A random order that stays the same all day.

stops.title: Albums
stops.text: Every album, single and EP in its place.

stops.title: Artists
stops.text: Every artist, composer and feature, sorted out.

stops.title: Player
stops.text: A clean player built around your music, with cool yet calm effects.

android.title: Artwork Gestures
android.text: Tap, hold or double tap the artwork for actions you choose.

android.title: Track Menu
android.text: Tap the track info to open its menu.

android.title: Add to Playlist
android.text: Hold the heart to add the track to a playlist.

android.title: Seek Magnet
android.text: Let go near the start and it snaps right to 0:00.

android.title: Cancel Seeking
android.text: While seeking, swipe up to cancel.

android.title: Seek
android.text: Tap the position to seek back, or the duration to seek forward.

android.title: Back to Start
android.text: Hold previous to jump to the very start.

android.title: Speed Up
android.text: Hold next to speed up while you hold it.

windows.title: Artwork Gestures
windows.text: Click, hold or double click the artwork for actions you choose.

windows.title: Track Menu
windows.text: Click the track info to open its menu.

windows.title: Add to Playlist
windows.text: Hold the heart to add the track to a playlist.

windows.title: Seek Magnet
windows.text: Let go near the start and it snaps right to 0:00.

windows.title: Cancel Seeking
windows.text: While seeking, drag up to cancel.

windows.title: Seek
windows.text: Click the position to seek back, or the duration to seek forward.

windows.title: Back to Start
windows.text: Hold previous to jump to the very start.

windows.title: Speed Up
windows.text: Hold next to speed up while you hold it.

stops.title: Queue
stops.text: All your queues saved, pick up any of them where you left off.

branch.title: Play After
branch.text: Queue tracks up in the order you pick them.

branch.title: Swipe Actions
branch.text: Quick actions with a swipe, and you pick which ones.

branch.title: Shuffle Modes
branch.text: Shuffle and get the original order back, or shuffle just once.

branch.title: Queue Options
branch.text: Decide what happens when the queue ends.

stops.title: Lyrics
stops.text: Lyrics that light up line by line or word by word.

branch.title: Instrumental Breaks
branch.text: Lyrics step aside during instrumental breaks, so the artwork or video shows.

branch.title: Fullscreen Lyrics
branch.text: Sing along with lyrics on the whole screen.

branch.title: Lyrics Picker
branch.text: Pick the right lyrics and fix their timing.

branch.title: Romanization
branch.text: Sing along in languages you can't read.

branch.title: Lyrics Effects
branch.text: Lyrics animations as calm or lively as you like.

stops.title: Sound Effects
stops.text: Shape every track with a parametric EQ and sound effects, or switch to mono.

branch.title: Output Device
branch.text: Pick where Namida plays, bit-perfect when your device supports it.

branch.title: Audio Path
branch.text: See everything that happens to the sound on its way to you.

branch.title: Per Track Sound
branch.text: Give any track its own speed, pitch, volume and EQ.

branch.title: Presets
branch.text: Save your favorite sound and switch to it in one tap.

stops.title: Smooth Playback
stops.text: Crossfade, gapless playback and soft fades on play and pause.

android.title: Skip Silence
android.text: Skip the silent parts anywhere in a track.

android.title: Gapless Playback
android.text: No delay between tracks, the next one loads early.

android.title: Crossfade
android.text: Blend in where the track really fades out, smart styles even match the beats.

android.title: Play & Pause Fade
android.text: The sound fades in and out when you play or pause.

windows.title: Gapless Playback
windows.text: No delay between tracks, the next one loads early.

windows.title: Crossfade
windows.text: Blend in where the track really fades out, smart styles even match the beats.

windows.title: Play & Pause Fade
windows.text: The sound fades in and out when you play or pause.

stops.title: Moving with Music
stops.text: Effects in the player that move with what's playing.

tiles.title: Visualizers
tiles.text: Bars, waves and other styles that move with the music.

tiles.title: Particles
tiles.text: Particles bursting out with the beat.

tiles.title: Beat Rings
tiles.text: Rings grow out of the artwork on each beat.

tiles.title: Mirrored Bars
tiles.text: Bars mirrored around the waveform seekbar.

tiles.title: Outline
tiles.text: Bars running along the artwork's edges.

tiles.title: Animated Artwork
tiles.text: The artwork pulses with the music.

tiles.title: Party Mode
tiles.text: A soft glow around the edges, in the artwork's colors.

stops.title: Music Videos
stops.text: Namida finds the video of a track (on your device or on YouTube) and plays it with the music.

branch.title: Video Source
branch.text: Pick local videos or YouTube, or let Namida try local ones first.

branch.title: Loop Animations
branch.text: Turn a short clip into an animated artwork.

stops.title: YouTube
stops.text: YouTube inside Namida, with your feed, channels and notifications.

branch.title: Without an Account
branch.text: History, playlists and subscriptions kept in Namida, no account needed.

branch.title: YouTube History
branch.text: Its own history and most played, apart from your music.

branch.title: Notifications
branch.text: Play every unread video in one go.

stops.title: Miniplayer
stops.text: Comments and related videos, without leaving the video.

android.title: Seek & Speed
android.text: Double tap a side of the video to seek, or hold it to speed up.

android.title: Fullscreen
android.text: Swipe up on the video for fullscreen, or down on its right side for portrait.

android.title: Segments & Heatmap
android.text: SponsorBlock segments and the most replayed parts show on the seekbar. Sponsors can be skipped, or cut out of downloads.

android.title: Dislikes
android.text: Dislike counts are back, thanks to Return YouTube Dislike.

windows.title: Segments & Heatmap
windows.text: SponsorBlock segments and the most replayed parts show on the seekbar. Sponsors can be skipped, or cut out of downloads.

windows.title: Dislikes
windows.text: Dislike counts are back, thanks to Return YouTube Dislike.

branch.title: Fullscreen
branch.text: Swipe for brightness and volume, lock the controls, or add a soft glow.

branch.title: Auto Dim
branch.text: The player dims itself after a few idle seconds.

stops.title: Downloads
stops.text: Download anything, properly tagged.

branch.title: Tags & Filenames
branch.text: Tags filled from the video title, and filenames built your way.

branch.title: Parallel Downloads
branch.text: Many downloads at once, and each one goes faster.

branch.title: Playlist Downloads
branch.text: Download a whole playlist at once, tagged and numbered.

stops.title: Streaming
stops.text: Watch, or just listen, the way you like.

tiles.title: Audio Only & Radio
tiles.text: Audio only, a radio after a single video, and suggestions without your account.

tiles.title: Data Saver
tiles.text: Set one level for Wi-Fi and another for mobile data.

stops.title: YouTube Playlists
stops.text: Your YouTube playlists, safe from videos randomly going missing.

stops.title: YouTube Search
stops.text: Search everything you watched, even offline.

stops.title: Stats
stops.text: Charts of your listening, from top tracks to your longest streak.

branch.title: Charts
branch.text: Compared with the period before, with rediscoveries, habits and completed albums.

stops.title: Listening Party
stops.text: Listen together with friends, in sync.

branch.title: On Your Network
branch.text: Host on your own network with no server, and invite with a code or QR.

branch.title: Shared Queue
branch.text: The same tracks found on every device, with YouTube to fill the gaps.

branch.title: Chat
branch.text: Chat with everyone in the room.

branch.title: Reactions
branch.text: React to what's playing, with your own emojis.

stops.title: Sync
stops.text: Sync your data between all your devices.

branch.title: Connect by IP
branch.text: Connect by address when devices can't find each other.

branch.title: Diagnostics
branch.text: A shareable report when something won't connect.

stops.title: Your Year
stops.text: Look back at your year in music.

stops.title: Tag Editor
stops.text: A powerful tag editor, from a single track to your whole library.

branch.title: Many Tracks
branch.text: Edit many tracks at once, mixed values stay as they are.

branch.title: Find & Replace
branch.text: Find and replace across tags, with a live preview.

stops.title: Lyrics Editor
stops.text: Make your own synced lyrics.

stops.title: Artists Map
stops.text: See how all your artists connect.

stops.title: Settings
stops.text: Tune every detail: themes, playback, the player, YouTube and more.

stops.title: Around the Player
stops.text: Small tools for the way you listen.

tiles.title: Sleep Timer
tiles.text: Stop playback after a number of tracks or minutes.

tiles.title: Bookmarks
tiles.text: Mark spots in a track or video to come back to them.

tiles.title: Track Menu
tiles.text: Repeat a track a few times, or stop after any track in the queue.

tiles.title: Add More
tiles.text: Add more from the same album, artist or folder, and hold + to pick how.

tiles.title: Shuffle
tiles.text: Shuffle a number of tracks, and leave out your recent listens.

tiles.title: Video Options
tiles.text: Hold the video button to pick the quality or audio track.

stops.title: Around the Library
stops.text: Small things that keep a big library in order.

tiles.title: Selection
tiles.text: Select tracks from different pages, then act on all of them at once.

tiles.title: Track Info
tiles.text: Tap any field to copy it.

tiles.title: Moods, Tags & Rating
tiles.text: Give tracks moods, tags and a rating, each one gets its own page.

tiles.title: Statistics
tiles.text: Listens and top tracks of any album, artist or selection.

tiles.title: Track Colors
tiles.text: Edit the colors of any track, and pick a mix.

tiles.title: Home Sections
tiles.text: Turn Home sections on or off, and reorder them.

stops.title: Around YouTube
stops.text: Small things that make YouTube nicer to use.

tiles.title: Cache Priority
tiles.text: Keep the videos you care about, even after they're gone from YouTube.

tiles.title: Channel Groups
tiles.text: Sort your channels into groups, then see only one group's videos.

tiles.title: YouTube Stats
tiles.text: Charts of what you watch, like the ones for your music.

tiles.title: Add to Playlist
tiles.text: Save videos to Namida playlists, or to your account.

tiles.title: Video Info
tiles.text: Info of any video, even private and deleted ones.

stops.title: Effects
stops.text: Plenty of calm effects behind the app, and some show up on their own each season.

tiles.title: Sakura
tiles.text: Falling petals, it shows up on its own in spring.

tiles.title: Rain
tiles.text: Soft falling streaks behind the pages.

tiles.title: Aurora
tiles.text: Aurora curtains colored by the current artwork.

tiles.title: Fireflies
tiles.text: Flickering glows over the whole app.

tiles.title: Fireworks
tiles.text: Fireworks bursting on the beat.

tiles.title: Deep Ocean
tiles.text: Glowing plankton, fish and jellyfish drifting by.

tiles.title: Starfield
tiles.text: Stars, sparkles and shooting stars.

tiles.title: Galaxy
tiles.text: A galaxy slowly spinning behind the app.

stops.title: Look & Feel
stops.text: Make the app look and feel the way you want.

tiles.title: Performance Mode
tiles.text: One switch between the best looks and the smoothest app.

tiles.title: App Icons
tiles.text: Pick the app icon you like.

tiles.title: Jellyfish
tiles.text: Let a few jellyfish drift around the app.

stops.title: Shortcuts
stops.text: Control playback and navigation from the keyboard.

stops.title: On Your Desktop
stops.text: Namida stays close while you use other apps.

windows.title: Tray
windows.text: Closing the window keeps Namida in the tray.

windows.title: Drag & Drop
windows.text: Drop files on the window to play them.

windows.title: Quick Rating
windows.text: Press Ctrl + Alt + 1..9 to rate the playing track.

windows.title: Mini Lyrics
windows.text: Press Ctrl + Alt + L to shrink Namida into a small lyrics window.

stops.title: Set As
stops.text: Use any track as your ringtone, notification sound or alarm.

stops.title: Notification Buttons
stops.text: Pick and reorder the buttons in the media notification.
